# A17-S38: Payment dispute

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

No, that can in no way be the case. We have written a very clear 
 contract, which is about me fulfilling a number of points within a 
 given period. Which I have done - and more. Furthermore, I have 
 worked in July to prepare the agreed workshops in collaboration with 
 partners, and to make a strategy for the fall.

You asked on the phone if I wouldn't also take some vacation, to which 
 I replied that it can be difficult when we don't mention vacation in the contract, 
[████] But since I carefully 
 fulfill everything in our contract, I simply cannot understand your email.

I actually want an apology for this email before we can talk
about a new contract. I simply cannot work without payment,
[████]
